name: taskmaster
description: Holds Claude to the workflow of the skill it loads: no silently skipped step, no completion without evidence, no lost place across compaction or a new session.

strictness.title: Strictness
strictness.description: How hard the gates hold: observe logs only, advisory warns, enforce denies and blocks, strict also needs your yes for a waiver.

maxStopBlocks.title: Stop blocks per turn
maxStopBlocks.description: How many times the Stop gate may hold one contract in a turn before it lets the stop through with a note. 1 to 5; anything else is moved into that range.

exemptSkills.title: Exempt skills
exemptSkills.description: Skills that never get a contract.

checkpointDir.title: Checkpoint folder
checkpointDir.description: Where checkpoints are kept, relative to the project root. A path outside the project is refused.

checkpointGit.title: Checkpoints in git
checkpointGit.description: commit: commit the checkpoint folder alone at each milestone. ignore: keep it out of git.

checkpointPush.title: Push checkpoints
checkpointPush.description: milestone: push each checkpoint commit, which a cloud container needs for it to outlive the session.

checkpointEveryWrites.title: Checkpoint every N writes
checkpointEveryWrites.description: Also write a checkpoint after this many write calls. 1 to 1000.

contextCheckpointPercent.title: Checkpoint at context %
contextCheckpointPercent.description: Ask for a checkpoint when the context window is this full. 10 to 95.

resumePolicy.title: Resume
resumePolicy.description: What a new session does with an unfinished run: offer it, resume it, or stay quiet.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Log gate decisions and run summaries to the metrics folder. Nothing leaves the machine.

metricsDir.title: Metrics folder
metricsDir.description: Where metrics are kept, relative to the project root. A path outside the project is refused.

ratingSample.title: Ask for a rating in 1 of N runs
ratingSample.description: At most once an hour. 0 never asks; 100 at most.

experiment.title: Experiment
experiment.description: on assigns each run an arm (baseline, generic or frontmatter), for evaluations.

experimentWeights.title: Experiment weights
experimentWeights.description: Relative weights of the baseline, generic and frontmatter arms, as three numbers like 2/1/1, not all zero.

experimentBlind.title: Hide the arm
experimentBlind.description: Hide which arm a run is in, so ratings aren't biased.

rca.title: Root-cause analysis
rca.description: manual: run /taskmaster retro to analyse queued incidents. off: queue nothing.

rcaDailyCap.title: Root-cause analyses per day
rcaDailyCap.description: At most this many model calls a day for /taskmaster retro. 0 to 50.

circuitBreakerThreshold.title: Friction signals before advisory
circuitBreakerThreshold.description: After this many of your overrides in one session, the mod drops to advisory for the rest of it. 1 to 20.

overrideDir.title: Override folder
overrideDir.description: Where per-skill contract overrides are kept, relative to the project root. A path outside the project is refused.
